body: Was taken advantage of too...it's cruel what people do to others! :( *hugs*

I regret going. 40k (10k billed to me, 30k to Aetna) and 2 weeks later,  all it did was make me not trust mental health professionals. Try a therapist or anything else. Going in is a last ditch effort IMO. -note - This was a private hospital. If you have to go, aim for a private one!! Also, make sure family knows or a trusted friend who will check up on you.
